SEARCH
Package model.users

Class Teacher

java.lang.Object
model.users.User
model.users.Employee
model.users.Teacher
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Researcher, Observer
public class Teacher extends Employee implements Researcher, Serializable
Represents a university Teacher. A Teacher extends Employee and optionally implements Researcher (any teacher can publish papers after being assigned a Researcher role).
